title: Chlamydomonas chloroplast
author: Papaefthimiou, Dimitra
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-zero

steps.title: Clone CO‑CcCLS into vector
steps.instruction: Insert the codon‑optimized CcCLS coding sequence (CO‑CcCLS), without its transit peptide, as an N‑terminal FLAG‑tag fusion into the pCG2‑FLAG chloroplast expression vector, placing it under the PSBD promoter/5′UTR and PSBA terminator/3′UTR to generate pCG2‑FLAG‑CO‑CcCLS.

steps.title: Transform cw15 strain
steps.instruction: Introduce the pCG2‑FLAG‑CO‑CcCLS construct into the chloroplast of the cell‑wall‑less Chlamydomonas cw15 strain using the glass‑bead transformation method (Demurtas et al., 2013).

steps.title: Select transformants on spectinomycin
steps.instruction: Plate the transformed cells on TAP agar plates supplemented with 100 µg ml⁻¹ spectinomycin and incubate until colonies appear.

steps.title: Achieve homoplasmy by subculturing
steps.instruction: Pick individual colonies and subculture them for ten successive rounds on the same TAP‑spectinomycin medium to eliminate all wild‑type copies of the chloroplast genome, thereby attaining homoplasmy.

steps.title: Verify integration and homoplasmy by PCR
steps.instruction: Extract chloroplast DNA from each subcultured line and perform PCR with the appropriate primers (as in Fig. 2) to confirm correct insertion of CO‑CcCLS and homoplasmy.

steps.title: Record transformation outcomes
steps.instruction: Test a total of 79 transformants by PCR; 49 of them should show correct integration and homoplasmy. For documentation, select 17 representative transformants for gel imaging, of which 12 are expected to display the correct integration pattern.
